projects.title: Rainstorm
projects.description: Web-based ideation and writing tool using randomization and intentional constraints to spark creativity.
projects.about: Rainstorm helps writers, musicians and other creatives move past the blank page. Inspired by roll-tables from tabletop RPGs, it combines random word generation with a drag-and-drop canvas to help you explore and organise ideas.
projects.challenge: Creating an intuitive, lightweight UX that sparks creativity without overwhelming the user, and ensuring full compliance with the European Accessibility Act (2025) while making a visual drag-and-drop workspace.
projects.results: A highly polished, interactive immersive experience built with dnd-kit, Framer Motion, and Howler.js. Designed with zero onboarding friction, it is actively used by indie game designers and musicians to kickstart new projects.
highlights: Tactile, interactive workspace featuring complex drag-and-drop mechanics and optional audio
Zero-friction onboarding with no accounts required, actively used by a small community of creators
Full keyboard accessibility engineered to meet the strict European Accessibility Act guidelines

projects.title: Papercut
projects.description: Optimized a 10+ year old legacy WooCommerce store, creating a fast hybrid React/Algolia search and filter experience and a streamlined checkout flow.
projects.about: Papercut is a independent bookshop in Stockholm. I was tasked with modernizing their decade-old WordPress/WooCommerce platform, improve legacy code to boost performance, overhauling the checkout UX, and introducing new product discovery tools.
projects.challenge: The original store suffered from slow query times, compounded by an outdated search function that lacked any filtering capabilities. In a niche catalog like Papercut's, this made it difficult to discover new products.
projects.results: By refactoring the backend logic and optimizing data retrieval, I significantly cut down page load times. By developing a custom WordPress plugin using instant search and faceted filtering, this hybrid architecture delivers immediate interface feedback, drastically lowering user friction.
highlights: Optimized & refactored 10+ year old legacy code
Developed a custom WordPress plugin integrating React and Algolia for a fast hybrid filtering solution
Transformed product discovery with instant, multi-faceted search and a friction-free checkout UX

projects.title: Demokrati Uppropet
projects.description: Campaign site for a democratic manifesto, built and launched in 48 hours.
projects.about: Headless one-page campaign site for Kristna Fredsrörelsen, built by me and a designer to amplify a democratic manifesto ahead of Sweden's 2026 election. The platform prioritizes reach, high readability, and effortless social sharing.
projects.challenge: The primary challenge was the strict 48-hour deadline. Operating primarily as the developer, I had to rapidly implement a headless Next.js setup while making swift design decisions to ensure an effective layout.
projects.results: The site launched successfully and on time. With an intentional, minimalist design, we ensured that the typography and core message took center stage. Integrating the native Web Share API allowed visitors to distribute the manifesto across mobile and desktop.
highlights: Rapid development and deployment with a short 48-hour deadline
Made fast, execution-focused design decisions without sacrificing quality
Leveraged the native Web Share API to drive organic engagement

projects.title: Ligan
projects.description: Fullstack league tracker and leaderboard for tabletop gaming, built through an experimental AI-driven workflow.
projects.about: Ligan is a fullstack web app built to track results, standings, and achievements for a competitive hobby gaming group. It simultaneously served as a hands-on experiment in AI-assisted development using Claude Code.
projects.challenge: The technical hurdle was implementing secure auth, real-time database schemas in Supabase, and dynamic score calculations. The workflow challenge was managing the AI: while Claude excelled at rapid coding, it required human intuition to steer pure mathematical logic into house rules that are actually fun for real players.
projects.results: The app is actively used every week by our gaming group with role-based authority for match reporting. Iterating through the project delivered a robust tool with an engaging achievement system, while providing me with deep expertise in optimizing AI pair-programming workflows for fast, reliable deployment.
highlights: Developed fullstack architecture with dynamic leaderboards, Supabase database, and secure server-side auth
Designed and implemented a complex, dynamic achievement and point calculation system
Conducted an in-depth exploration of advanced AI-assisted engineering workflows to drastically cut development time
